title: OpenCloudAgentsFinding
description: Canonical schema for machine-readable findings emitted by Open Cloud Agents specialists and deterministic linters.

$schema.description: URI of the finding schema version.

id.description: Deterministic finding identifier derived as FND- + SHA256(rule_id:resource:evidence)[0:12].

agent.description: Identifier of the agent or tool that produced the finding.

origin.description: The generator origin of the finding.

rule_id.description: Relative path to the canonical rule specification in rules/ directory.

category.description: Functional engineering or security domain category.

resource.description: Cloud or infrastructure resource identifier (e.g. Terraform address, Kubernetes resource, cloud ARN).

fact.description: Verifiable factual assertion regarding resource configuration.

evidence.description: Explicit evidence locator URI referencing diff hunk, repo baseline file, or cloud resource.

confidence.description: Certainty score. Explicitly null for deterministic linters, float in [0.0, 1.0] for model assertions.

retry_count.description: Number of retries attempted before producing valid finding.
